source.label: Tencent Annual Report 2025, consolidated statement of cash flows
Tencent Annual Report 2025, note on expenses by nature (research and development)
source.quote: During the year ended 31 December 2025, the Group had incurred expenses for the purpose of R&D of approximately RMB85,747 million (2024: RMB70,686 million)

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Taxes: 'Income tax paid' in operating cash flows (net line as presented). R&D: Tencent's income statement has no separate R&D line; the expenses-by-nature note discloses R&D expenses incurred of about RMB85,747 million (mainly employee benefits of about RMB63,620 million) and says no significant development expenditures were capitalised.
